sources.summary: Promotion: entries are now open for this year's edition of the Brick in Architecture Awards, which recognises the best brick buildings from the US and beyond. The annual award, which is accepting entries until 25 September, was established by the Brick Industry Association in 1989 to highlight architecture projects that "push the boundaries of design" The post Entries open for The Brick in Architecture Awards 2026 appeared first on Dezeen .

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: World Architecture Festival, in partnership with Make Architects and Sir John Soane's Museum, has opened entries for the ninth edition of The Architecture Drawing Prize, sponsored by Iris Ceramica Group. Open to architects, designers and students worldwide, the competition welcomes drawings of any type or form, from conceptual sketches to technical and construction drawings, cutaways and perspective views, whether relating to built, unbuilt or purely speculative projects. Entries are judged on an overall basis rather than by category, with multiple winners and a special prize for hand drawing.
